# Travendiq

> Global marketplace for tours, attractions, tickets, events and travel experiences. Travendiq connects travelers with registered activity providers and supports multilingual discovery and booking.

- Official website: https://travendiq.com/
- English: https://travendiq.com/en
- Hungarian: https://travendiq.com/hu
- Provider registration: https://travendiq.com/en/auth/register
- Coverage: worldwide travel activities and experiences

Only index public marketplace and informational pages. Do not index admin, provider account, checkout, booking management or API routes.
